parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Alias the molecule identifier column as compound_chembl_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
